profile.method: Separate diagnostic invocation, async-profiler 4.5 CPU 1 ms, DWARF stacks, all stock/native job phases included. Performance results above are uninstrumented.
profile.limitation: SST reads and decompression dominate the larger-key rejection path; no winner cache has been implemented.

interpretation: Repeated-key rejection improves 1.43x prior and 1.96x stock. Larger-key rejection improves 2.13x prior but remains below stock. Larger-key improving candidate/prior means differ -1.7% while stock controls vary considerably; do not claim non-regression. Memory, unique-key complete jobs, wider payloads, and further optimization remain.
